description.title: Description

citations.description: One or more citations supporting the conflict entry.

action_id.description: Short stable identifier for the action item
action_id.title: Action Id

description.description: Description of the action assigned or agreed in the meeting
description.title: Description

owner.description: Owner of the action item, only when explicitly stated in the transcript and normalized against the participant list
owner.title: Owner

due_date.description: Due date of the action item, only when explicitly stated in the transcript
due_date.title: Due Date

uncertainty_reason.description: Explanation of why owner or due_date is null when not explicitly stated
uncertainty_reason.title: Uncertainty Reason

citations.description: List of one or more citation strings supporting the action item
citations.title: Citations

decision_id.description: A short stable slug for the decision record.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

statement.description: A concise statement of what was decided.
statement.title: Statement

citations.description: At least one citation for the decision, using the specified pipe-delimited citation format.
citations.title: Citations

name.description: Name of the participant, normalized using the supplied participant list
name.title: Name

role.description: Role of the participant, normalized using the supplied participant list
role.title: Role

title.description: The agenda topic title that was actually discussed in the meeting.
title.title: Title

discussion_summary.description: A concise, neutral summary of what was said about the topic, grounded only in the transcript.
discussion_summary.title: Discussion Summary

description.description: Description of the topic or question raised in the meeting that was not resolved by the end of the discussion.
description.title: Description

citations.description: List of at least one citation supporting the unresolved issue entry.

description: Extraction model for MeetingRecord with repeated participants, topics, decisions, action_items, unresolved_issues, conflicts

meeting_id.description: A stable identifier for this meeting instance.
meeting_id.title: Meeting Id

title.description: The meeting title as stated in the agenda or transcript.
title.title: Title

meeting_date.description: The date the meeting was actually held, per the transcript if stated there; leave unset if neither source states it explicitly.
meeting_date.title: Meeting Date

start_time.description: As explicitly stated (agenda or transcript). Leave unset if not stated.
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: As explicitly stated (agenda or transcript). Leave unset if not stated.
end_time.title: End Time

review_status.description: Always set to pending_review in the extracted output.
review_status.title: Review Status

participants.description: One entry per confirmed meeting participant with name and role.
participants.title: Participants

topics.description: One entry per agenda topic that was actually discussed, with title and discussion_summary.
topics.title: Topics

decisions.description: One entry per explicit decision made in the meeting, including decision_id, statement, and citations.
decisions.title: Decisions

action_items.description: One entry per action assigned or agreed in the meeting, including action_id, description, owner, due_date, uncertainty_reason, and citations.
action_items.title: Action Items

unresolved_issues.description: One entry per topic or question raised but not resolved, including description and citations.
unresolved_issues.title: Unresolved Issues

conflicts.description: One entry per contradiction between agenda and transcript or within the transcript, including description and citations.
conflicts.title: Conflicts

title: MeetingRecord_Extraction
